data.name: Pundalik
data.gender_notes: Pundalik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A man who was a great devotee of Lord Shiva. He was a simple shepherd who lived in the village of Shivapur. Despite his lowly status, he was a deeply devoted follower of Lord Shiva and would often perform rituals and offerings to the deity. His unwavering faith and devotion eventually earned him the blessings of Shiva and he was granted the title of 'Pundalik'.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the unwavering faith and devotion towards a deity or a higher power. It represents the selfless service and dedication to the divine.
data.etymology: Pundalik belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Devotee of Lord Shiva.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pundalik total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_sanskrit.name: पुण्डलिक
in_sanskrit.meaning: पुण्ड (punḍa) - to heap, collect; लिक (lika) - mud; पुण्डलिक (punḍalika) - one who collects mud
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who collects mud or cleanses the earth.

in_hindi.name: पुण्डलिक
in_hindi.meaning: पुण्ड (punḍa) - उठाना (uṭhāna) - to heap, collect; लिक (lika) - प्रभात (prabhāta) - dawn; पुण्डलिक (punḍalika) - संदहन (saṃdahan) - one who purifies, cleanses
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who purifies or cleanses at dawn by collecting mud.

in_tamil.name: புன்டலிக

in_telugu.name: పుందలిక
in_telugu.meaning: పుంద (puṁda) - to heap, collect; లిక (lika) - mud; పుందలిక (punḍalika) - one who collects mud
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who collects mud or cleanses the earth.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Pundalik is a name revered in Hindu mythology, derived from the word 'pundit' meaning wise or learned. This name represents the spirit of dedication, sacrifice, and unwavering faith in one's beliefs.
